Players

Enjoy. Track. Share. Repeat.

Bring back the fun

Cut arguments. focus on the game.
No more line-calling fights ruining your focus. Challenge it and move on.
The feedback gets real-time
Set a target, start a drill, measure, repeat, beat the target. Your real-time performance is right in your hand. After the game, track your performance, compare it to your past and get a clear picture of the things to work on. May the data be with you.
